external_games.name: Nioh 3 - Hellfrost Equipment Set (Hellfrost Warrior Armor set + Hellfrost Ninja Attire set)

name: Nioh 3: Hellfrost Equipment Set
summary:
A set that includes every piece of Hellfrost Warrior Armor and Hellfrost Ninja Attire.

- This set will be made available via Boons under Preparations in the Shrine menu.
- Hellfrost Warrior Armor can be equipped while in Samurai Style. To equip it, change to Samurai Style, access the main menu, select Equipment or Items, and then select this equipment.
- Hellfrost Ninja Attire can be equipped while in Ninja Style. To equip it, change to Ninja Style, access the main menu, select Equipment or Items, and then select this equipment.
